source_says: Governor's Year 1 list, row 9: 'Nuvita Health'   439,775.40, Northeast Region. Name, amount and region only -- no form, no project text.
why_ambiguous: Florida publishes no organisation form; the owner's workbook coded it UNCLASSIFIED/Unclear and session 49 re-typed it (VENDOR_OR_CONTRACTOR) without settling the hospital column.
determination: OWNER-CONFIRMED (session 58): 'Nuvita Health' is Nuvita Cellular Health, a cellular preventive medicine and biomarker testing platform -- not a hospital.
